question: As of October 2020, who is the Chairman of the Fifteenth Finance Commission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nand Kishore Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​The Finance Commission **is constituted by the President under** article 280 **of the Constitution.
 
• The commission's chairman is** Nand Kishore Singh,** a senior member of the Bharatiya Janata Party since March 2014, with its full-time members.
 
• **Nand Kishore Singh **is an Indian politician, economist and former Indian Administrative Service officer.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​​Bimal Jalan** is a former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.
 
• **Ajay Narayan Jha** is a 1982 batch Indian Administrative Service officer of Manipur Cadre.
 
• **Shaktikanta Das** is currently serving as the 25th governor of the Reserve Bank of India.
